name: mcp-selfhost
description: Private self-hosted Desktop Commander MCP with verifiable identity and namespaced tools.

interface.shortDescription: Use the verified private self-hosted MCP path.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the local MCP Selfhost facade, verifies SELFHOST_E2E_OK, and exposes Desktop Commander tools with a selfhost_ prefix so calls cannot be confused with the hosted Remote Desktop Commander connector.
defaultPrompt: Verify MCP Selfhost identity, then inspect my local development environment safely.
Use only selfhost_ tools for this task and show the identity marker first.
Check MCP Selfhost health and report the upstream tool count.
